literal_meaning: To trap or ensnare (like putting a noose around something)
similar_in_english: Let the cat out of the bag
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বন্ধুর গোপন কথা ফাঁস করে দিল।
যেন কেউ ফাঁস না করে, সতর্ক থেকো।
example_sentences_in_english: He let out his friend's secret by mistake.
Be careful so that no one spills the beans.
note: This idiom derives from the idea of trapping, metaphorically applied to exposing hidden information in everyday Bengali speech.
